checks.evidence: Prime pods create exposes noninteractive launch flags.
Prime pod status can emit JSON for SSH/pod metadata capture.
Prime availability can emit JSON with pricing fields.
Pod bootstrap script has execute bits.

runbook_steps.guard: Must succeed before any pod creation.

runbook_steps.command: prime --plain availability list --gpu-type RTX6000Ada_48GB --gpu-count 1 --output json | jq '.gpu_resources[] | {id, cloud_id, gpu_type, gpu_count, provider, location, price_per_hour, price_value, stock_status}'
runbook_steps.guard: Choose an available resource whose estimated total keeps OpenAI plus GPU spend under $100. Prefer a noninteractive image-compatible resource; verify the provider supports the selected image before leaving a pod running.
Only run after live price and total budget are checked. Record the returned pod id.
Keep provider, GPU, image, created_at, and SSH metadata with the prediction artifacts.

runbook_steps.command: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 <pod-ssh-target> 'echo connected && nvidia-smi'
runbook_steps.guard: Must pass before syncing the repo or running training. If SSH fails, terminate the pod immediately and record the wallet debit as a failed SSH-preflight attempt.

runbook_steps.command: Use the SSH target from pod status to rsync this repo to the pod, excluding node_modules, dist, .git, and unrelated large artifacts.
runbook_steps.guard: Do not copy secrets or .env files. The smoke does not need OpenAI credentials.
Run inside the synced repo on the GPU pod.
Must fetch predictions.jsonl, result.json, report.md, smoke_manifest.json, and remote_smoke_bootstrap_manifest.json.
Only after artifacts exist and Prime billing/cost is known.
Terminate immediately after artifacts are fetched or on any failure.

llm_budget.note: This runbook generates local files and reads no authenticated Prime resources.
